**Checklist**

- [ ] `python -m unittest` passes.
- [ ] A new counting rule has a synthetic case and a mutant that `python tests/mutate.py` catches.
- [ ] No real transcript anywhere in the change.
- [ ] New case has a test with the expected result written by hand.
- [ ] Examples use made-up data only, no real data about any person or company.
- [ ] Text in English; behavior change in CHANGELOG.md.
- [ ] Your own code, under the project's MIT license (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
